pilotMechanism.statute: New Jersey Long Term Tax Exemption Law (N.J.S.A. 40A:20)
pilotMechanism.pilotExplanation: In Montville Township, 30-year PILOT agreements pay an Annual Service Charge to Town Hall (95%) and the County (5%), while the public schools receive $0 statutory allocation.

sampleProjects.name: Towaco Station (350 Units)
sampleProjects.location: Main Redevelopment Corridor, Montville Township, NJ

taxpayerSolutions.title: Mandatory 50% PILOT School Revenue-Sharing in Montville Township
taxpayerSolutions.proposal: Enact a municipal ordinance transferring at least 50% of residential PILOT service charges directly to Montville Township Public Schools.
taxpayerSolutions.benefit: Prevents single-family homeowners from paying 100% of the educational cost for new apartment complexes.

taxpayerSolutions.title: Commercial Ratable Modernization & Retention
taxpayerSolutions.proposal: Rezone vacant commercial corridors for high-value research, medical, and technology ratables that generate property taxes with zero school enrollment load.
taxpayerSolutions.benefit: Restores commercial ratable share from 15.9% toward 35%, cutting residential taxes.
